chatprd.reason: The MCP protected resource publishes only email and profile. The Clerk authorization server also advertises openid, offline_access, public_metadata, private_metadata, and user:org:read. Those are not requested.

cloudflare-connector.reason: The protected resource and the 401 challenge advertise only account:read and user:read. The authorization server catalog also lists write and admin scopes such as workers-scripts.write and dns.write. Those are not requested.

composio-connector.reason: The protected resource publishes no scopes. The authorization server's whole list is OIDC identity plus offline_access for the refresh_token grant. email is the identity claim, not a mailbox scope. Per-app grants stay in Composio Connect Apps and must not be added here.

convex-connector.reason: The plugin starts the local Convex CLI MCP server. It does not send an OAuth scope parameter; Convex login stays in the CLI outside this manifest.

folios.reason: Folios ships skills only and does not declare an MCP server or an OAuth client.

framer.reason: Framer connects with FRAMER_API_KEY on the local framer-mcp-server process. No OAuth scopes are requested.

friskydev-mcp.reason: The gateway publishes a single scope, frisky.mcp. The authorization server does not offer a refresh grant, so offline_access is not requested.

magic-patterns.reason: The protected resource publishes only these four OIDC scopes, including offline_access. There is no narrower product scope to select, and no further scope is requested.

n8n-connector.reason: Instance OAuth on n8n.friskydev.com. Live metadata was unreachable on 2026-10-03 (Cloudflare tunnel error 1033), so the client must not add scopes until a reviewed protected-resource list exists.

perplexity.reason: The protected resource publishes only perplexity_api. The authorization server also advertises offline_access, which is not requested.

render.reason: Connect with a dedicated Render API key. The hosted server can challenge OAuth but publishes no scopes_supported. This plugin does not attach scopes. Re-audit if the protected resource starts advertising any.

sentry-connector.reason: The plugin only reads issues, events, releases, traces, and replays. Of the scopes the protected resource publishes, only org:read is requested. project:write, team:write, event:write, and alerts:write are declined.
